title: Lightweight Night Cream for Humid Weather: A Non-Greasy Guide
ex: How to choose a light, non-greasy night cream for humid Indian weather, how much to use, and a simple routine for sticky summer and monsoon nights.
rt: Lightweight Night Cream for Humid Weather | Mirc Glow
rd: Lightweight night cream for humid weather: textures that suit Indian summers, how much to use, signs a cream is too heavy and a simple non-greasy routine.
keyword: lightweight night cream for humid weather
quick: In humid weather, choose a gel-cream or light whipped night cream with ingredients like aloe vera, niacinamide or hyaluronic acid. Use about half a pea-sized amount in a thin layer and let it settle for ten minutes. Do not skip cream completely, and wear sunscreen every morning.
facts: Gel-creams and whipped creams suit humid nights best
Half a pea-sized amount is often enough in summer
Skipping cream can leave skin dehydrated and oilier
AC rooms may need a little more cream on the cheeks
